mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dart_corp_code (corp_code, stock_code, corp_name, corp_eng_name, modify_date) VALUES
(#{item.corpCode}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.corpName}, #{item.corpEngName}, #{item.modifyDate})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_code = VALUES(stock_code), corp_name = VALUES(corp_name), corp_eng_name = VALUES(corp_eng_name), modify_date = VALUES(modify_date), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
